How to order coffee in Greece like a pro ☕🇬🇷 Recorded at @Pandrossos_Hotel_Paros 😍*invited  Greece’s coffee culture is on another level, with some iconic coffees that locals drink every single day. Of course, Greece also has cappuccinos, lattes, americanos, flat whites and all the other coffees you’re used to. But if you’re coming to Greece, you have to try ordering coffee the local way. Here’s exactly how it works. Step one: choose your coffee. ☕ Frappé Made with instant Nescafé and water, mixed until it becomes thick and foamy. The original Greek iced coffee. ☕ Freddo Espresso A cold espresso shaken with ice until it’s frothy and refreshing. ☕ Freddo Cappuccino A freddo espresso topped with a thick layer of cold milk foam. ☕ Ελληνικός Καφές (Ellinikós Kafés) Traditional Greek coffee made in a small briki pot. It’s served with the coffee grounds still inside the cup and is traditionally used for coffee reading. Now comes the important part. How sweet do you want it? 🖤 Σκέτο (Skéto) = no sugar 🤎 Μέτριο (Métrio) = medium sweet 🍯 Γλυκό (Glykó) = sweet You can also choose which sweetener you’d like: 🍬 Ζάχαρη (Záchari) = regular sugar 🤎 Μαύρη Ζάχαρη (Mávri Záchari) = brown sugar 💊 Ζαχαρίνη (Zacharíni) = saccharin 🌱 Στέβια (Stévia) = stevia If you want milk, you can ask for: 🥛 Γάλα (Gála) = regular milk 🌾 Γάλα Βρώμης (Gála Vrómis) = oat milk 🌰 Γάλα Αμυγδάλου (Gála Amygdálou) = almond milk 🥥 Γάλα Καρύδας (Gála Karýdas) = coconut milk 🌱 Γάλα Σόγιας (Gála Sógias) = soy milk If you’re ordering a freddo cappuccino, they’ll often ask if you want: ✨ Κανέλα (Kanéla) = cinnamon 🍫 Κακάο (Kakáo) = cacao And if you’re ordering a frappé, many places will also let you add a scoop of ice cream 🍨 One thing many tourists don’t know: Freddo espresso and freddo cappuccino are usually made with TWO shots of espresso. If you’d rather have a lighter coffee, ask for: ☕ Μονή Δόση (Moní Dósi) = single shot ☕ Ελαφρύ (Elafrý) = light My personal order? ☕ Ένα Φρέντο Καπουτσίνο Μέτριο, με Μαύρη Ζάχαρη, Κανέλα και Μονή Δόση (Ena Frénto Kapoutsíno Métrio, me Mávri Záchari, Kanéla kai Moní Dósi) A freddo cappuccino, medium sweet, with brown sugar, cinnamon and a single shot. Some more examples: ☕ Ένα Φραπέ Γλυκό με Γάλα (Ena Frappé Glykó me Gála) A sweet frappé with milk. ☕ Έναν Φρέντο Εσπρέσο Σκέτο (Enan Frénto Esprésso Skéto) A freddo espresso without sugar. ☕ Έναν Ελληνικό Καφέ Μέτριο (Enan Ellinikó Kafé Métrio) A medium-sweet Greek coffee. ☕ Ένα Φρέντο Καπουτσίνο με Γάλα Βρώμης και Στέβια (Ena Frénto Kapoutsíno me Gála Vrómis kai Stévia) A freddo cappuccino with oat milk and stevia. Pt.4 | My fall bakery menu 🍂 Recipe below 👇🏼  Crumbl released their Dubai Chocolate Brownie, but why buy it when you can make an even better one at home? 🤎✨ Ingredients 🟤Brownie Base * 180g caster sugar * 2 eggs * 113g unsalted butter (for browning) * 170g chopped chocolate * 80g plain flour * 3 tbsp cocoa powder * ½ tsp salt 💚Kunafa Filling * 260g kunafa pastry (finely chopped) * 2 tbsp unsalted butter (for toasting kunafa) * 320g pistachio cream 🍫Chocolate Ganache * 120g double cream * 100g milk chocolate (chopped) Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper. 2. Brown 113g of unsalted butter in a saucepan until golden, then set aside. 3. Melt the chopped chocolate in the microwave in short bursts until smooth, then stir in the browned butter and let cool slightly. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. 5. Add the chocolate butter mixture to the eggs and sugar, and whisk until fully combined. 6. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just incorporated. 7. Pour all of the brownie batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and bake for 22 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan. 8. In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add the finely chopped kunafa pastry and cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Let cool slightly. 9. Mix the toasted kunafa pastry with the pistachio cream until fully combined, then spread evenly over the cooled brownie. 10. Place the pan in the fridge for about 30 minutes to set. 11. For the ganache, place the double cream and chopped milk chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in short bursts, stirring in between, until melted and glossy. 12. Pour the ganache over the pistachio-kunafa layer, spread evenly, and refrigerate, ideally overnight, or at least 1 hour before slicing. Enjoy! 🤎 #baking #dubaichocolate #brownies #Recipe #fall

Raising Cane’s-Style Chicken Fingers With Cane’s Sauce. Ingredients: For the Chicken: - 2 lb chicken breast, cut into strips - Oil for frying For the Wet Batter: - 2 cups buttermilk - 2 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tbsp black pepper - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp smoked paprika For the Dry Batter: - 2 cups all-purpose flour - 3 tbsp cornstarch - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tsp black pepper - 1 tsp smoked paprika For the Cane’s Sauce: - 1 cup mayonnaise - 4 tbsp ketchup - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tsp black pepper - Salt to taste - 1 tsp smoked paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the wet batter by whisking together buttermilk, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. Add the chicken strips to the wet batter and marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight. 2. Prepare the dry batter by whisking together flour, cornstarch, salt, garlic powder, black pepper, and smoked paprika. 3. Remove the chicken from the wet batter, allowing excess to drip off, then coat each strip in the dry batter. 4. Deep-fry the coated chicken strips in hot oil (about 350°F) until golden brown and cooked through, approximately 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through. 5. Prepare the Cane’s Sauce by whisking together mayonnaise, ketchup,Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. 6. Serve the crispy chicken fingers with Cane’s Sauce. #canessauce #raisingcanes #friedchicken #chickentenders #Recipe
